application that unifies media downloading, conversion, playback, DLNA

**Windows**, **Linux**, and **Android** — no Electron, no browser overhead,

JPG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, WebP, ICO), archives (ZIP, TAR.GZ, CBZ), and media (MP3, 
WAV, AAC, FLAC, OGG, MP4, MKV, WEBM) |
temp_src\README.md:26:| **Bulk Import** | Parse track lists and batch-download

temp_src\README.md:35:Full in-app browser with intelligent URL normalization — 
bare domains (`hianime.to`), IP addresses (`192.168.1.1`), ports 
(`localhost:8080`), and search queries are all handled automatically. YouTube 
URL detection supports standard watch links, Shorts, embeds, live streams, and 
`music.youtube.com`.
temp_src\README.md:38:Extended the download service beyond YouTube to support 
**any site that yt-dlp supports** (~1,800 sites). The `downloadGeneric()` 
pipeline provides progress reporting, human-readable error messages 
(geo-blocks, private content, rate limits), and automatic format conversion 
via FFmpeg.

README.md:17:Because it runs natively on Windows, Linux, Android, and macOS,

keep the full downloader available.

enabled.

documents, images, archives, and media files.
